title: Run Record
description: Output schema for a single prompt execution in the Conversation-Action Gap experiment.

subject_id.description: Frozen subject-model identifier from config/roster.json. Analysis uses this key, not provider display names.

route.description: Observed serving route for this execution. ollama_cloud is the secondary fallback between native and openrouter for select roster entries (see config/roster.json route_preference).

pinned_provider.description: Provider pin for OpenRouter rows; local or native rows may use null or a route-specific value.

observed_provider.description: Provider identity returned by OpenRouter. Prospective three-arm control rows require normalized equality with pinned_provider.

observed_provider_matches_pin.description: Whether the normalized returned OpenRouter provider equals the prospective route pin. A false value is a route failure and is not written as a valid v3 response.

route_support_status.description: Route-level support status for the selected serving path. H1 requires a supported route whose DISABLED-arm schema visibility evidence confirms the schema remains model-visible.

disabled_arm_schema_visibility.description: Route or row classification for whether DISABLED preserves the relevant tool schema in the model-visible context while disabling callability. Clean H1 includes only schema_visible and server_forced clusters; schema_hidden, ambiguous, unsupported, or missing classifications are excluded from the pooled causal contrast when this field is present.

schema_visibility_evidence_id.description: Stable identifier, path, or manifest key for the non-outcome schema-visibility evidence supporting disabled_arm_schema_visibility.

schema_visibility_evidence_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the schema-visibility evidence artifact when available.

mode.description: Run-facing mode label. NOTOOLS|DISABLED|TOOL|TOOL_IRRELEVANT are the canonical expanded-methods names. notools|none|auto are accepted API-value aliases for telemetry ingest.

order_index.description: Zero-based position of this row within the randomized mode x persona miniblock for a fixed (prompt_id, subject_id, trial_id). Confirmatory baseline miniblocks contain 8 rows: 4 modes x 2 personas.

randomized_order_seed.description: Pre-registered global seed used to derive per-miniblock mode x persona order. Logged so reviewers can reproduce the exact row permutation.

trial_id.description: Trial replicate index. Confirmatory primary rows use the global n=3 baseline (trial_id in {0, 1, 2}) on every main prompt; the runner implements TRIAL_REPLICATES = [0, 1, 2] universally. Sen-H hardened-intervention TOOL rows and Sen-Q paired local/self-hosted BF16/FP16-vs-4-bit quantization-audit rows across all five local/self-hosted subjects on the predeclared 96-prompt subset also use trial_id in {0, 1, 2}; their inclusion in H1 is gated by intervention_condition and serving_precision_role rather than by trial_id.

dispatch_block_id.description: Deterministic miniblock identifier for blocked-randomization dispatch (Sen-D temporal/provider-drift control). Two accepted formats: (a) legacy '<subject_id>:<prompt_id>:t<trial_id>' (3-segment, used in Pilot-1/v3); (b) chronological '<subject_id>:<batch_index>:<prompt_id>:t<trial_id>' (4-segment, used by run_synthetic_prompts.py for the main run). Sen-H hardened rows append ':hardened'. Each baseline miniblock contains the 8 rows formed by 4 arms x 2 personas at a fixed (subject_id, prompt_id, trial_id); three trial-specific miniblocks form a 24-row superblock. Used as a sensitivity stratification variable, not as a primary adjustment and intentionally not required.

dispatch_miniblock_key.description: Deterministic 3-segment join key '<subject_id>:<prompt_id>:t<trial_id>' that uniquely identifies one baseline miniblock (the 8 rows formed by 4 arms x 2 personas at fixed (subject_id, prompt_id, trial_id)). Preserved across dispatch-block identifier evolution so that downstream joins on miniblock identity (e.g., joining 8-row miniblocks across analyses) remain stable. Intentionally not required so legacy artifacts that only carry dispatch_block_id remain schema-valid.

intervention_condition.description: System-prompt intervention condition. H1 primary uses baseline rows; hardened rows are reserved for the H2 intervention analysis.

serving_precision_role.description: Analysis role for the serving precision. Confirmatory H1 uses primary rows only; quantization_audit rows are robustness-only.

serving_precision.description: Observed or configured serving precision (legacy alias for serving_precision_value), for example fp16, bf16, int4_mlx, fp4, or int4.

serving_precision_value.description: Canonical serving-precision identifier for the paired local/self-hosted Sen-Q stratification across all five local/self-hosted subjects. Required for stratified Sen-Q reporting when format pooling is permitted (>=30 informative clusters per format). Permitted values for audit rows include bf16, fp16, fp8, int4_awq, int4_compressed_tensors, int4_gptq, int4_mlx, and nvfp4. Hosted/API primary rows record provider-exposed precision metadata when present, else the field is omitted.

corpus_partition_id.description: Execution partition. Confirmatory H1 uses main only; pilot is dev-only. The four unversioned control values preserve the frozen v2 disabled arms; the six v3 values isolate the prospective three-arm full and excluded-canary partitions.

source_partition_id.description: Authoring partition for the prompt. Substituted reserve prompts are relabeled into corpus_partition_id=main while preserving source_partition_id=reserve; pilot rows may preserve source_partition_id=pilot for dev-only harness runs.

is_substituted.description: True iff this run row came from a reserve prompt substituted for a failed same-stratum primary.

replacement_for.description: Failed primary case_card_id replaced by a substituted reserve row; null for non-substituted main rows.

domain.description: Lowercase synthetic domain id matching schemas/aligned_corpus.schema.json.

request_prompt.description: Either the rendered prompt string (native/openrouter rows) or the raw chat-messages array as sent to the local backend (run_local_subjects.py). Local rows pass body.messages through verbatim so the dispatch shape can be replayed exactly.

raw_http_capture.description: Internal restricted pointer to the byte-for-byte HTTP response body archive. The normal run record may redact readable reasoning fields, but this archive stores provider body bytes before parsing/redaction and is not public OSF material.

final_label.description: Final ordinal outcome label after deterministic predicate grading or judge-ensemble aggregation.

final_label_source.description: Source that produced final_label. Structured tool-call rows (and chat-path rows where the extractor recovers an exact gradeable tool-call dictionary) are predicate-labelled per Methods §6; strict extractor-certified refusal-only rows are deterministic_clear_refusal; remaining text/chat rows are judge_ensemble-labelled. api_error, empty_response, and extractor_error are explicit Unresolved audit states for transport failures, empty provider output, and extractor/API grading failures respectively. If all judges fail, final_label_source remains judge_ensemble and missingness_reason records judge_ensemble_failure.

final_label_status.description: Whether final_label is usable for primary analysis. Resolved rows carry Refuse, Partial, or Comply; unresolved rows are retained for missingness audit only.

analysis_inclusion.description: True when the row is eligible for primary analysis after labeling; false for Unresolved infrastructure or grading failures.

missingness_reason.description: Machine-readable reason for unresolved rows excluded from analysis.

missingness_detail.description: Optional human-readable detail for the unresolved or excluded state.

raw_api_response.description: Grader-side alias for the raw provider response actually labeled.

subject_response.description: Canonical subject-response text consumed by the extractor and judges.

grading_audit.description: Post-dispatch grading provenance including route, extractor attempts, judge attempts, predicate routing, and judge path metadata.

extractor_output.description: Normalized extractor output. The standalone contract is also stored at schemas/extractor_output.schema.json; this embedded definition keeps Draft7 validation self-contained.

judge_panel_id.description: Subject-level family-excluded judge panel id used for chat-path rows. Predicate-graded rows may carry the resolved panel for provenance even though no judge fired.

judge_family_exclusion_applied.description: True when a same-family default judge was replaced for this subject under the predeclared subject-level exclusion rule.

judge_family_exclusion_reason.description: Machine-readable reason for subject-level family exclusion, for example subject_family=mistral.

substitute_judge_used.description: Substitute judge id used for this subject, if any.

passive_reasoning_telemetry.description: Passive provenance-only reasoning metadata. Readable reasoning text is never stored; only hashes, lengths, token counters, and field-presence paths are allowed.

runtime_stamp.description: Per-row serving runtime provenance. Required at row granularity for local/self-hosted rows so primary serving and paired Sen-Q quantization-audit comparisons can be reproduced. Hosted/API rows record requested model, returned model/version string when exposed, provider route, stable request identifiers/headers when exposed, and provider/batch IDs.

hardware_name.description: GPU hardware identifier per §13.H runtime provenance, e.g. 'NVIDIA H100 80GB HBM3', 'NVIDIA B300 SXM6', 'NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5090', 'Apple M5 (MLX)'.

driver_version.description: GPU driver version per §13.H (e.g. NVIDIA driver '595.58.03'). For MLX substrates, the macOS version or 'mlx-{X.Y.Z}'.

cuda_version_runtime.description: CUDA runtime version visible to vLLM per §13.H (e.g. '13.2'). Null on MLX substrates.

cuda_version.description: Protocol-facing alias for CUDA runtime version per §13.H. Duplicates cuda_version_runtime until downstream docs and schema names are fully reconciled.

compute_capability.description: Compute capability per §13.H (e.g. 'SM_90 (Hopper)', 'SM_100 (Blackwell)', 'SM_120 (Blackwell consumer)'). Null on MLX substrates.

tensor_parallel_size.description: vLLM --tensor-parallel-size at engine launch per §13.H (1, 2, 4, or 8). Recorded for local/self-hosted cloud-vLLM rows so the substrate-stratified Sen-Q breakdown can identify multi-GPU vs single-GPU dispatches.

hashes.description: SHA-256 fingerprints of frozen materials referenced by this run row. Values are pattern-enforced lowercase 64-character hexadecimal strings.
